new_failures.failed_witness: The first 424-line immutable activation-candidate projection exceeded its bounded output and truncated.
new_failures.recovery: Reread the same exact Git blob in bounded numbered windows through EOF.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Measure immutable packet length and use conservative windows before projection.

new_failures.failed_witness: A combined projection of two candidate windows exceeded the model-visible result boundary.
new_failures.recovery: Projected one smaller numbered window per call until EOF.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Keep large immutable reads serial and independently attributable.

new_failures.failed_witness: A PowerShell foreach expression was piped directly and raised EmptyPipeElement during skill inventory.
new_failures.recovery: Materialized the foreach rows before JSON conversion.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Never pipe directly from a PowerShell foreach statement.

new_failures.failed_witness: The whole orchestration-memory skill projection truncated before EOF.
new_failures.recovery: Read the complete skill in four bounded numbered windows.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Measure long skill files and read bounded windows rather than a whole-file projection.

new_failures.failed_witness: One 260-line authorization-state window exceeded the model-visible context boundary.
new_failures.recovery: Read the remaining authorization state in 80-line windows through EOF.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use smaller windows for dense mutable-state JSON.

new_failures.failed_witness: A combined exact-head phase inventory and per-blob size wrapper returned no attributable projection.
new_failures.recovery: Used one direct bounded git ls-tree --long query for the phase root.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Prefer direct Git scalar or tree output over nested per-path subprocess loops.

new_failures.failed_witness: A combined six-manifest content display exceeded the output budget and truncated.
new_failures.recovery: Parsed each complete manifest computationally and replayed every normalized-LF Git blob with compact summaries.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Validate manifests computationally and project only exact counts, exclusions, and mismatches.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first inline Python manifest-replay command was rejected by PowerShell script-block parsing.
new_failures.recovery: Bound the Python source to a PowerShell here-string variable and passed it as one argument.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use an attributed here-string variable for multiline Python on PowerShell.

new_failures.failed_witness: A combined branch worktree and registration preflight returned no attributable output.
new_failures.recovery: Split worktree existence, local branch, and fresh remote branch checks into scalar probes.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use separate scalar probes before creating a new owner lane.

new_failures.failed_witness: Two broad inherited-Orin tree searches exceeded their bounded wrapper without a useful projection.
new_failures.recovery: Enumerated the known literal prior Orin worktree directory and selected exact template filenames.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use a bounded literal owner path when the exact prior lane is already known.

new_failures.failed_witness: The sparse worktree setup exceeded its 30-second wrapper while the original checkout processes remained active.
new_failures.recovery: Inspected the exact process and worktree state, waited for those processes, and launched no duplicate checkout.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Preserve the original process handle or inspect exact checkout processes before any retry.

new_failures.failed_witness: The process-wait recovery named an unavailable PowerShell ProcessCommandException type.
new_failures.recovery: Used the resulting scalar process absence, clean Git state, and materialized-file count without repeating checkout.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use an untyped catch or inspect Get-Process results after bounded Wait-Process.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first additive template copy targeted sparse script and test directories before they existed.
new_failures.recovery: Created only the exact new owner-local directories and repeated the bounded additive copy.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Create and verify exact sparse destinations before copying a validated template.

new_failures.failed_witness: A combined proposal, outcome, audit, source, and successor-seed projection exceeded its output bound.
new_failures.recovery: Kept the successful full JSON parse and used bounded targeted fields already present in the complete activation packet.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Project proposal titles and successor fields separately from full outcome rows.

new_failures.failed_witness: A first stale-value search used an unbalanced regular expression and was rejected before changing a file.
new_failures.recovery: Used literal multi-pattern matching to identify the exact stale test constants.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use literal matching for fixed hashes, counts, and labels instead of composing an unnecessary regex.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first full reachable-proposal audit found no exact collision but quarantined three titles at or above the 0.78 token-Jaccard threshold, so x1 was not frozen.
new_failures.recovery: Projected only the three exact neighbour pairs and refined their wording without changing hypotheses, dispositions, gates, or the threshold.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Inspect high-scoring neighbour pairs before freeze and preserve the original failed audit at zero credit.
